feedback:
index.html: 10585 bytes
layout 7.0/10: The order is clear (hero plus offer, a three-column feature row, a details row, a closing CTA band, then the footer) with good spacing, but the 'Close to the metro / Stay focused into the night' row is small, sparse and looks like an afterthought, and the feature columns are plain text, so the page 
mobile 7.0/10: On the phone the page is a clean single column with comfortable line lengths and a large, easy-to-tap NIGHT/Copy keyword block, and the offer card comes in at about the first fold, but nothing about it is designed for the phone first (no sticky CTA, the hero pushes the offer down, small helper text)
[cli:claude] Turn the small 'Close to the metro / Stay focused into the night' row into a prominent section that speaks to the late-night visitor's worries (e.g. study undisturbed until 02:00 with staff on site, a key card keeps the room secure after 01:30, 6 minutes back to the metro), and give it the same visual weight as the feature row.

first_impression.evidence: Work or classes all day? A quiet place to prepare for graduate-school, civil-service or certification exams awaits you at night.
first_impression.why: The first desktop screen pairs a large serif headline and a supporting line aimed at day-busy exam takers with a cream offer card showing ¥129, the 50-sign-up limit and the NIGHT keyword step, but it falls short of 9 because the headline ('Make room for your future') never mentions night or exams, the urgency sits in a small pill, and the only action is a secondary-looking 'Copy keyword' button.

layout.evidence: Settle in. Get into your work.
layout.why: The order is clear (hero plus offer, a three-column feature row, a details row, a closing CTA band, then the footer) with good spacing, but the 'Close to the metro / Stay focused into the night' row is small, sparse and looks like an afterthought, and the feature columns are plain text, so the page doesn't reach 8.

visual_craft.why: The deep green background, cream cards, gold italic serif accent and matching tracked eyebrow labels make a coherent, calm late-night style that looks professionally made, held back from 9 by small, low-contrast secondary text (e.g. 'Included with your Night Membership'), an all-text feature area with no imagery or icons, and the italic 'f' sticking out past the left margin.

mobile.evidence: Copy, then send to the official account.
mobile.why: On the phone the page is a clean single column with comfortable line lengths and a large, easy-to-tap NIGHT/Copy keyword block, and the offer card comes in at about the first fold, but nothing about it is designed for the phone first (no sticky CTA, the hero pushes the offer down, small helper text), and the screenshot cuts off before the closing CTA.

persuasion.why: Every fact from the brief is here, the trial (¥129, then ¥199, first 50 sign-ups) and the keyword step are clear and honest, and booths, the phone-booth rule and the 22:00 milk are framed around the evening, but the safety and location facts are just listed as specs and never answer the late-night worries (getting home, being safe near closing), so it doesn't reach 8.

Every price, time, number and perk on th.why: ¥129, ¥199, 50 sign-ups, 18:00–02:00, 42 booths, lamp/2 sockets/USB-C, 4 phone booths, 22:00 milk, 01:30 key card, 02:00 staff, second floor and 6 minutes' walk all come from the brief, and there are no testimonials, ratings, member counts or extra perks ('Bring your books and plug in' is flavor copy, not a claim).

The page has no placeholder text, broken.why: There is no placeholder text or overlap in either screenshot. The only flaw is the italic 'f' in 'for your future.' sticking a few pixels past the left margin, which is cosmetic rather than broken.

judge_details.top_fix: Turn the small 'Close to the metro / Stay focused into the night' row into a prominent section that speaks to the late-night visitor's worries (e.g. study undisturbed until 02:00 with staff on site, a key card keeps the room secure after 01:30, 6 minutes back to the metro), and give it the same visual weight as the feature row.
